content.description:
<untrusted_participant_content>
I’m looking for someone to build AI bots(Grok Bot, Muse, Instinct, etc) and automations for my businesses and teach me how to use them.

We’ll start with my real estate business, but this will be an ongoing relationship. As I come up with new ideas and business needs, I’ll want help planning, building, and improving additional bots.

Initial Bots I Want Built
•	Client follow-up bot: Help manage texts and emails to buyers, sellers, past clients, and prospects.
•	Top leads bot: Track my priority buyer and seller leads, remind me who needs attention, and suggest next steps.
•	Calendar bot: Help with scheduling, appointment reminders, and follow-up tasks.
•	SEO and blog bots: Help research topics, draft website content, and identify SEO improvements.
•	GoHighLevel bot: Help manage contacts, pipelines, tasks, workflows, and reporting.

What I’m Looking For
•	Experience building practical AI bots and business automations.
•	Strong GoHighLevel experience.
•	Ability to connect CRMs, email, texting, calendars, and websites.
•	Familiarity with Grok/xAI, Muse, Instinct, ect or similar tools is a plus.
•	Clear communication and willingness to provide live training.
•	Someone who can recommend the simplest reliable solution—not overcomplicate things.

How We’ll Work
We’ll start with one small paid project, then build additional bots in separate stages. New ideas and requests will be scoped and priced separately, with the potential for ongoing work across all my businesses.
I’ll need documentation, training, and ownership of all accounts and workflows. Bots must protect client information and require my approval before sending messages, publishing content, or making important changes unless we agree otherwise.

To Apply
Please share:
1.	Examples of bots or automations you personally built.
2.	Your experience with GHL and AI tools.
3.	Your hourly rate and availability.
4.	Whether you can provide live screen-sharing training.

I’m looking for a long-term partner who can build with me as my businesses and ideas grow.
</untrusted_participant_content>
content.title: Grok AI Bot Specialist Needed — Build Automations & Train Me to Manage Them
